chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Abān, from Zurārah, from Abī Jaʿfar عليه السلام, who said:
"The punishment of the one who commits liwat is the punishment of the fornicator."

key_terms.حَدُّ: the fixed hadd punishment established in sacred law

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the hadd punishment for liwat?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning the hadd punishment for one who commits liwat, equating it with the hadd of the fornicator. It belongs to the jurisprudential discussions of prescribed punishments in Shia fiqh.
